query:
SELECT a.id as "id!: uuid::Uuid",
                  a.actor_id as "actor_id!: uuid::Uuid",
                  u.email as "actor_email!: String",
                  a.action as "action!: String",
                  a.document_id,
                  a.created_at as "created_at!: chrono::DateTime<chrono::Utc>"
           FROM audit_log a
           JOIN users u ON u.id = a.actor_id
           WHERE a.case_id = $1
           ORDER BY a.seq ASC
